title: Turo no Kaa Bɔ wɔ Adekyee
intro: Wɔ nnɔnhwerew a na ɛhɔ yɛ dinn ansa na owia apue no, wɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe bi wɔ kokoam. Agyapade a ɛrenya nkɔso gyinaa hɔ a wɔasiesie ama otwa, nanso wɔhyehyɛɛ bo a wɔasi sɛ wɔbɛma aba biara atwe wɔn ho afi wɔn a wohia mmoa ho. Eduu anɔpa no, na biribiara bɛyɛ te sɛ nea wonnim, na na wɔakyerɛw asuade bi wɔ nkorabata a ayɛ tuntum mu ama wɔn a wosusuw nneɛma ho nyinaa.
clues: Yenyaa turo a na ɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm fii awo mu na yɛkaa ntam sɛ yebetwa emu aba nyinaa ama yɛn ho.
Yɛkaa ntam sɛ yebepue anɔpatutuutu bere a na ahiafo a wɔsrɛɛ wɔn kyɛfa no da so ada.
Yeyii biribiara a yeyi firii yen ntam no mu na yesiee hokwan a ahiafo no wɔ a yɛanka sɛ Allah pɛ a.
Yefii adi bɔɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho asereserew sɛ yɛmma ohiani biara kwan mma ɔnhyɛn yɛn turo mu saa da no.
Yɛyɛɛ yɛn ho mfonini sɛ yebetumi aboaboa biribiara ano koraa na yɛasiw obiara a ɔboaboa nneɛma ano no kwan sɛ ɔrennye kyɛfa bi.
Yɛsɔree na yehuu sɛ yɛn turo no asɛe anadwo, ayɛ tuntum te sɛ nea wɔatwa, na yɛkae sɛ wɔahwere yɛn na yɛanu yɛn ho.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
